title.original: ProServe: Unified Multi-Priority Request Scheduling for LLM Serving
title.zh: ProServe：LLM服务的统一多优先级请求调度
title.en: ProServe: Unified Multi-Priority Request Scheduling for LLM Serving

inclusion_reason.zh: ProServe 将优先级收益、实例内组批和跨实例路由统一为可复用的分布式 LLM 服务调度框架。
inclusion_reason.en: ProServe unifies priority-aware gain, engine batching, and cross-instance routing in a reusable distributed LLM scheduling framework.

abstract.zh: ProServe 将多优先级 LLM 请求调度形式化为服务收益最大化问题，同时考虑 SLO 达成与客户业务价值。其两级架构在单实例内自适应组批，并在分布式实例间按收益与能力路由。
abstract.en: ProServe formulates multi-priority LLM scheduling as service-gain maximization, combining SLO attainment with client value. Its two-tier architecture adapts batches inside each engine and routes by expected gain and instance capability across the service.

problem.zh: 既有调度器通常只优化统一的时延目标，无法让业务关键请求获得更强保证，也不能把优先级收益与集群能力联合考虑。
problem.en: Existing schedulers usually optimize a uniform latency objective and cannot jointly account for differentiated client value, latency targets, and heterogeneous instance capability.

approach.zh: SlideBatching 用滑动边界在负载与优先级间动态组批；异步换出、流水重载和复制预算降低抢占代价；GoRouting 则为未来高优先级或长请求预留容量。
approach.en: SlideBatching uses a moving boundary to form priority-aware batches; asynchronous offload, pipelined reload, and copy budgeting reduce preemption cost; GoRouting reserves capacity for likely high-value or long requests.

system_design.zh: 引擎层维护滑动批次边界和可抢占 KV 块管理器，服务层汇总实例能力与收益预测进行分发；两层共享请求优先级与 SLO 信号。
system_design.en: The engine layer maintains sliding batch boundaries and a preemptible KV-block manager, while the service layer dispatches from capability and gain estimates; both consume common priority and SLO signals.

key_results.zh: 在四个开源与一个工业数据集上，ProServe 被报告可提高总体服务收益和 SLO 达成率。
key_results.en: Across four open datasets and one industrial workload, ProServe is reported to improve aggregate service gain and SLO attainment over prior schedulers.

limitations.zh: 服务收益取决于业务赋值与请求长度预测；摘要未讨论错误优先级、低优先级饥饿或跨租户策略公平性。
limitations.en: Service gain depends on business valuation and request-length forecasts; mislabeled priorities, starvation of low-priority traffic, and cross-tenant policy fairness are not addressed in the abstract.

notes.zh: 数据集数量、优先级场景和两项上限来自官方摘要；模型、硬件、工业数据身份和具体基线待全文审计。
notes.en: Dataset counts, priority setting, and two upper bounds come from the official abstract; models, hardware, industrial dataset identity, and named baselines await full-text audit.
